findings.title: The regression test does not guard early validation ordering
findings.detail: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/mod.rs:821-875 claims unsupported pins are refused before banners or destructive prompts, but it only checks the returned error and sets yes=true. I moved both validations from lines 279 and 522 back after their prompts and startup banners; the intended test remained green and emitted all three banners. Restore was byte-identical and the test was green again. Add CLI-boundary assertions that invalid copy/mirror/move commands emit neither startup output nor prompts.

findings.title: The adaptive-default assertion makes an uncontrolled remote connection attempt
findings.detail: crates/blit-cli/src/transfers/mod.rs:861-875 proves checkers=0 is accepted by continuing through the real remote-pull path against host:/src/ and expecting connection failure. This performs DNS and network I/O, took 1.29s here, and can behave differently or write under /dst if that hostname resolves to a Blit daemon. Use a deterministic post-gate rejection or test the helper directly for this negative case.
